thread.title: Stock Market Today: Tech Stocks Outperform; These Two FANGs Receive Price-Target Hikes

author: SCOTT LEHTONEN
title: Stock Market Today: Tech Stocks Outperform; These Two FANGs Receive Price-Target Hikes
text:
The major market averages were solidly higher in early trade Wednesday ahead of the release of the Fed's minutes at 2 p.m. ET in the stock market today .
X The tech-heavy Nasdaq once again outperformed with a 0.5% gain. The S&P 500 and Dow Jones industrials followed up with rises of 0.3% and 0.2%, respectively, as they continue to fight around their 50-day moving average lines.
Within the Dow industrials , Walmart ( WMT ) extended losses early Wednesday, falling an additional 1% after Tuesday's earnings-related 10% rout. The stock pierced its 50-day line in heavy volume and closed right at its lows, indicating a slew of sellers.
Elsewhere, Apple ( AAPL ) padded its gain above its 50-day line, as it rose 0.7%. The stock is looking to form a brand-new base after its previous breakout sputtered and failed.
FANG stock Amazon.com ( AMZN ) advanced about 1% after MKM Partners raised its price target on the e-commerce giant from 1,350 to 1,750 — a near-30% increase and a 19% premium to Tuesday's closing price. The stock has been a stalwart even during the market's recent sell-off, as it found support at the 50-day line and rallied back to its highs.
Meanwhile, fellow FANG Netflix ( NFLX ) traded around 1% higher, as it approached a new 52-week high. The stock is just 2% off a new high. Piper Jaffray raised its price target from 281 to 315 on the video streamer, saying international subscribers are less likely to leave Netflix if it were to raise prices again.
